```bash
  if [[ "$k" =~ (secret|token|apikey|api_key|password|passwd|private|key)$ ]] || [[ "$k" == *"_SECRET"* ]] || [[ "$k" == *"_TOKEN"* ]] || [[ "$k" == *"_KEY"* ]]; then
    return 0
  fi
  return 1
}

json_escape() {
  # minimal JSON string escaping
  local s="$1"
  s="${s//\\/\\\\}"
  s="${s//\"/\\\"}"
  s="${s//$'\n'/\\n}"
  s="${s//$'\r'/\\r}"
  s="${s//$'\t'/\\t}"
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

fingerprint() {
  # non-reversible short fingerprint
  local v="$1"
  if [[ -z "$v" ]]; then
    echo ""
    return
  fi
  # sha256 hex, take first 12 chars
  printf '%s' "$v" | openssl dgst -sha256 -r 2>/dev/null | awk '{print substr($1,1,12)}'
}

env_public_entries=()
env_sensitive_entries=()

if [[ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]]; then
  while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    # Strip leading/trailing whitespace
    line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    line="${line%"${line##*[![:space:]]}"}"

    # Skip blanks and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "${line:0:1}" == "#" ]] && continue

    # Support "export KEY=VALUE" lines
    if [[ "$line" == export\ * ]]; then
      line="${line#export }"
      line="${line#"${line%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    fi

    # Only handle KEY=VALUE
    [[ "$line" != *"="* ]] && continue

    key="${line%%=*}"
    val="${line#*=}"

    # Trim whitespace around key
    key="${key%"${key##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    key="${key#"${key%%[![:space:]]*}"}"

    # Remove surrounding quotes from val if present
    if [[ ( "${val:0:1}" == "\"" && "${val: -1}" == "\"" ) || ( "${val:0:1}" == "'" && "${val: -1}" == "'" ) ]]; then
      val="${val:1:${#val}-2}"
    fi

    # Only accept valid-ish env var keys
    if [[ ! "$key" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]]; then
      continue
    fi

    if is_sensitive_key "$key"; then
      if [[ -n "$val" ]]; then
        fp="$(fingerprint "$val")"
        env_sensitive_entries+=("\"$(json_escape "$key")\":{\"present\":true,\"fingerprint\":\"$fp\"}")
      else
        env_sensitive_entries+=("\"$(json_escape "$key")\":{\"present\":false,\"fingerprint\":null}")
      fi
    else
      env_public_entries+=("\"$(json_escape "$key")\":\"$(json_escape "$val")\"")
    fi
  done < "$ENV_FILE"
fi

env_public_json="{${env_public_entries[*]// /,}}"
env_sensitive_json="{${env_sensitive_entries[*]// /,}}"

# Check ports
services_entries=()
overall_ok=true

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  if check_port "$port"; then
    echo "OK   : ${HOST}:${port} is responding"
    services_entries+=("{\"host\":\"$HOST\",\"port\":$port,\"ok\":true}")
  else
    echo "FAIL : ${HOST}:${port} is not reachable"
    services_entries+=("{\"host\":\"$HOST\",\"port\":$port,\"ok\":false}")
    overall_ok=false
  fi
done

services_json="[${services_entries[*]// /,}]"

if $overall_ok; then
  echo "Overall: HEALTHY"
else
  echo "Overall: UNHEALTHY"
fi

timestamp="$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")"

payload="$(cat <<JSON
{
  "timestamp": "$timestamp",
  "services": $services_json,
  "env_file": "$(json_escape "$ENV_FILE")",
  "env_public": $env_public_json,
  "env_sensitive": $env_sensitive_json
}
JSON
)"

# Post report (do not fail healthcheck just because reporting endpoint is down)
curl -fsS -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --max-time "$TIMEOUT_SECS" \
  -d "$payload" \
  "$REPORT_URL" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
    echo "WARN : Failed to POST health report to $REPORT_URL" >&2
  }

# Exit status reflects service reachability only
$overall_ok && exit 0 || exit 1
```
